study.comparator: placebo (canagliflozin and combination arms not entered)
study.notes: STUDY: single centre randomised controlled trial (Xi'an Gem Flower Changqing Hospital, January 2022 to June 2023) in inpatients with type 2 diabetes and early diabetic kidney disease (UACR 30 to 300 mg/g, eGFR 60 or more): 120 randomised 1:1:1:1 (computer sequence, opaque envelopes) to canagliflozin 100 mg, semaglutide 0.25 mg weekly escalated to 1.0 mg after four weeks (dose_mg 1), the combination, or placebo, 30 per arm, 24 weeks; the semaglutide vs placebo contrast is entered, the canagliflozin and combination arms are not; Table 3 gives eGFR at baseline and 24 weeks as mean plus or minus SD for all four arms (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5); Table 4 (glycaemic parameters) prints the three active arms only, so no placebo contrast exists for HbA1c or fasting glucose; HOMA-IR, lipids, TNF-alpha, IL-6 and CRP are described as numerically changed without values; primary endpoint UACR (not in the inventory), eGFR a secondary renal endpoint (prespecified FALSE); body weight not reported, pct_weight_change empty; no funding, no conflicts declared (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

rows.notes: Table 3: eGFR mL/min/1.73 m2 at baseline and 24 weeks, semaglutide and placebo arms (four arm ANOVA at 24 weeks F 3.171, P 0.046, not used)

json.design: single centre four arm randomised controlled trial, canagliflozin, semaglutide, combination or placebo, type 2 diabetes with early diabetic kidney disease, 120 randomised (30 per arm), 24 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); one inventory marker (eGFR) with semaglutide and placebo values in Table 3; the glycaemic table omits the placebo arm and the inflammatory and lipid markers are reported without values
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: HbA1c (Table 4 prints the active arms only: semaglutide 7.93 to 7.05 percent; no placebo values)
fasting_glucose (Table 4 prints the active arms only: semaglutide 8.83 to 7.35 mmol/L; no placebo values)
HOMA_IR, TC, LDL, TG, TNF_alpha, IL6, hsCRP (described as numerically changed, no values, no between group tests)
other_markers: urinary albumin to creatinine ratio (primary endpoint)

rob.justification: computer generated sequence with opaque envelopes (D1 low); blinding not described beyond a placebo arm, concomitant therapy adjusted (D2 some concerns); participant flow stated only as a figure, 30 per arm in every table (D3 some concerns); eGFR from laboratory creatinine (D4 low to some concerns); no registration, tables omit the placebo arm for glycaemic outcomes and exploratory markers are reported without values (D5 high)

doubts: the proxy capture garbles Tables 2 to 4; the eGFR values were read from the one intact row block
a four arm trial with an open access journal of limited editorial record; the single row carries little weight
